title: Compare two folder trees and find duplicate folders — in the browser, no install
user: People verifying a backup copy, merging old drives or photo dumps who need to know whether one folder is fully contained in another and which folders are exact duplicates.
smallest_useful_product: A static offline PWA that selects two local folder trees, hashes files locally, computes per-folder Merkle hashes, classifies identical/contained/different trees, lists file differences and duplicate folders, exports reports, and quarantines reviewed duplicates.
constraints: File System Access API is Chromium-only; provide a read-only directory-upload fallback.
All file names and contents stay on device.
Destructive operations must be reversible through quarantine.
Symlinks and unreadable files must be reported honestly.
